---
title: "Headless / CLI"
description: "Run the same ProtVis import, search, preprocessing, checkpoint and export backends without the Shiny interface."
---

## Why use headless mode?

ProtVis 0.9.1 exposes a command-line workflow through `ProtVis::run_protvis_cli()` and the installed `exec/protvis` script. It is useful for servers, batch jobs, reproducible pipelines and projects that should run without an interactive Shiny session.

The CLI uses the same core dataset, search, checkpoint, provenance and export functions as the GUI.

## Table-based input

```bash
Rscript -e "ProtVis::run_protvis_cli()" --args \
  --input proteins.tsv \
  --source DIA-NN \
  --output results
```

Use the source name that matches the input parser. The imported table is harmonized into `ProtVis_dataset` before later stages run.

## Raw-data search with Sage

```bash
Rscript -e "ProtVis::run_protvis_cli()" --args \
  --engine Sage \
  --fasta proteins.fasta \
  --mzml-dir ./mzML \
  --sample-info samples.csv \
  --output results
```

Sage is the default raw-search engine in the CLI.

## Raw-data search with FragPipe

```bash
Rscript -e "ProtVis::run_protvis_cli()" --args \
  --engine FragPipe \
  --fasta proteins.fasta \
  --spectra-dir ./spectra \
  --sample-info samples.csv \
  --fragpipe-workflow LFQ-MBR.workflow \
  --output results
```

Use `--fragpipe-path` when auto-detection cannot find the official runtime.

## Resume an existing project

```bash
Rscript -e "ProtVis::run_protvis_cli()" --args \
  --resume results \
  --output results
```

Resume uses the same checkpoint/workflow-state logic as Project Dashboard.

## Useful options

```text
--engine Sage|FragPipe
--fragpipe-workflow LFQ-MBR.workflow
--fragpipe-path /path/to/fragpipe
--stages noise_correction,transformation,imputation,normalization,...
--config analysis.json
--no-downstream
--help
```

A JSON configuration is preferable when many parameters must be fixed for repeated runs.

## Complete help

```r
ProtVis::protvis_cli_help()
```

## Reproducibility

A production CLI run should archive the command/configuration, ProtVis version and commit, input fingerprints, search-engine version, result registry, workflow status and portable `ProtVis_dataset` export.

Because schema v4 is append-only, re-running a stage adds a new run and preserves the earlier state instead of silently overwriting provenance.

::: {.callout-tip}
Use the GUI for interactive exploration and the CLI for fixed, repeated production runs. Both routes operate on the same project model.
:::
